overrides.replacement_claim: Sprint summary projections used by the performance status API, server-rendered workbench, and TUI bypass durable-run enrichment, so operational lifecycle and cancellation state remain empty even when a correlated durable run exists.
overrides.reason: Both theories identify the same projection defect. The aggregate helper delegates directly to the state projection, the dashboard embeds that result, and the API and presentation surfaces consume it without the durable-run enrichment performed by the dedicated PerformanceStatus use case.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance evidence endpoint has a compatibility path that returns an unversioned ad hoc artifact payload instead of the schema-versioned PerformanceEvidenceResult DTO.
overrides.reason: The handler explicitly returns a map lacking schema_version, records, and next_cursor when the separately optional evidence-query capability is absent.

overrides.replacement_claim: The public performance configuration table documents hard maxima above the built-in defaults even though validation rejects every value above its built-in default, causing documented supported values to fail configuration loading.
overrides.reason: The documented table lists multiple hard maxima above defaults, while validation consistently uses DefaultPerformance values as ceilings for configurable values.

overrides.replacement_claim: PerformanceResult returns an unclassified raw error when no terminal result exists, bypassing performance-specific transport error mapping.
overrides.reason: The unavailable-result branch returns a plain error, while the HTTP performance mapping recognizes only PerformanceUseCaseError values.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance failure path can publish a flow-state summary after its verification writer token becomes stale because it does not recheck the writer fence immediately before SaveFlowState.
overrides.reason: The failure path checks ownership when publishing performance state, then loads and saves flow state without another fence check, leaving a race window before the separate publication.

overrides.replacement_claim: Publishing bounded performance evidence metadata containing artifact references and digests is documented behavior; the supplied criteria prohibit raw evidence and sensitive values, not these metadata fields.
overrides.reason: The supplied documentation expressly promises bounded evidence references and sample-free evidence metadata. No supplied requirement forbids exposing contained artifact references or digests, and the cited error contract does not establish such a prohibition.

overrides.replacement_claim: The JSON performance-output parser accepts malformed trailing content after an otherwise valid envelope because it rejects only a second decode that succeeds; any non-EOF decoding error is treated as acceptable trailing data.
overrides.reason: The second decode is not checked specifically for EOF, so malformed trailing syntax produces a non-nil error that the parser accepts.

overrides.replacement_claim: A fenced or commented pseudo `## Performance Targets` heading is ignored by target parsing but still treated as a declaration during policy validation, causing a false `performance policy mismatch` when performance policy is disabled.
overrides.reason: Target parsing applies fence and comment exclusions, but policy validation uses separate heading-presence detection; the supplied tests cover pseudo-sections only at the parser boundary.

issues.claim: Malformed trailing bytes after a valid performance JSON envelope are accepted instead of rejected.
issues.title: Performance JSON parser accepts malformed trailing data
issues.reason: The parser treats every second-decode error as acceptable rather than requiring io.EOF.

issues.claim: Disabled-policy validation falsely treats fenced or commented Performance Targets headings as declarations.
issues.title: Pseudo performance headings trigger policy mismatch
issues.reason: Declaration detection does not demonstrably share the parser's pseudo-section exclusions.

issues.claim: The evidence endpoint can return an unversioned fallback payload incompatible with its schema-versioned DTO.
issues.title: Evidence fallback violates the versioned response contract
issues.reason: Adapters lacking the optional evidence capability receive a successful response with a different field set and no schema version.

issues.claim: Requesting an unavailable performance result returns an unclassified error and bypasses performance-specific HTTP translation.
issues.title: Unavailable performance results lose error classification
issues.reason: The raw error is not recognized by the performance use-case error mapper used at the transport boundary.

issues.claim: A stale performance writer can modify flow state because the failure path does not fence immediately before SaveFlowState.
issues.title: Flow-state failure publication lacks a final writer fence
issues.reason: Ownership may change after performance-state publication and before the independently durable flow-state write.

issues.claim: Documented performance hard maxima above defaults are rejected because runtime validation uses defaults as ceilings.
issues.title: Performance limit documentation contradicts validation
issues.reason: Values publicly documented as within hard maxima cannot pass configuration loading.

issues.claim: Aggregate performance projections bypass durable-run enrichment, leaving lifecycle and cancellation fields empty on the API, HTML workbench, and TUI.
issues.title: Performance summaries omit durable run state
issues.reason: Presentation surfaces consume the aggregate projection rather than the dedicated enriched status result.
